Surgery Information.Surgery Findings: Completed pancreatico-duodenectomy with pancreatico-jejunostomy, and per op report, mass was adherent to the portal vein. Pathology revealed 4.6cm pancreatic head adenocarcinoma with +PNI, +SM at the SMA margin with 11/46 lymph nodes positive

Symptoms or Side Effects.Side Effect: wound infection in his left neck incision

Additional Comments: The patient, a 64-year-old male with a history of resected pancreatic adenocarcinoma, has been managing his condition with supportive treatments including Creon for nutritional support. He has experienced complications such as ascites, which improved following the stenting of the portal vein. Additionally, he has poorly controlled diabetes with an HbA1c level greater than 12, and there is a recommendation to refer him to a new primary care physician if his current health plan permits. His lower extremity edema and abdominal distension have shown improvement. The patient is accompanied by his daughter and is in agreement with the current management plan.
